description: One object of this type specifies a mail receiver, meaning an email address
It is used e.g. when submitting jobs via `qsub -M user[@host][,user[@host],...]`
@todo why do we split it into user and host? We could just have a single string holding an email address.

attributes.name: user
description: User name of the mail receipient

attributes.name: host
description: Host / Domain part of a mail receipient.
